levie.en:
Agents are going to use software 100X more than people will in the future. As a result, enterprise platforms will become headless and be able to work with any agent on or off platform. If you don’t do that you’re DOA.

What some have missed is that this creates vastly more use-cases for these platforms than even existed pre-AI. This isn’t zero sum. Software value props have traditionally been capped at the number of users you have in a company. Agents have no upper limit. 

We’re going to run agents to process data at a scale humans never could, they’re going to be running 24/7 in parallel doing work for us, and they can integrate workflows across systems to generate all new value propositions.

Once you embrace this approach, it becomes obvious how much more upside there is.
levie.zh:
未来，代理使用软件的数量将比人们多 100 倍。因此，企业平台将变得无头，并且能够与平台内外的任何代理合作。如果你不这样做，你就是 DOA。

有些人忽略的是，这为这些平台创造了比人工智能出现之前存在的更多的用例。这不是零和。传统上，软件价值道具的上限是公司中拥有的用户数量。代理没有上限。 

我们将运行代理以人类无法达到的规模处理数据，它们将 24/7 并行运行为我们工作，并且它们可以跨系统集成工作流程以生成所有新的价值主张。

一旦你接受了这种方法，你就会发现它还有多大的好处。

No Priors.en:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:40
The cost to replace an enterprise platform in this SaaS apocalypse that people talk about is an extraordinary expense. Let's take that cost, and then let's take the cost associated with the human capital doing that instead of something else because the platform was doing the work for you. And then let's add up the cost of the GPU factory and the tokens that will materially affect their business model. And so for a simple application on our platform, it would be 10 times...
No Priors.zh:
演讲者 1 | 00:00 - 00:40
在人们谈论的 SaaS 灾难中，更换企业平台的成本是一笔巨大的开支。让我们考虑这个成本，然后让我们考虑与人力资本相关的成本，而不是其他事情，因为平台正在为你做这些工作。然后我们将 GPU 工厂的成本和将对其商业模式产生重大影响的代币相加。所以对于我们平台上的一个简单应用程序来说，这将是 10 倍
